message:
test(ua2-apk r2): the current request by seq, window vs desktop, capability states -- unit, native, and the real APK on new and old hosts

- DesktopBackendPresentationTest 13: before the first pong = checking; older host never applied nor scoped;
  scope only with SESSION_SCOPED; logon-screen refusal is terminal (and stays so at later answers); the same value
  again is not done until its own answer (NotYetApplied -> applying -> applied); A/B/A late answer keeps the latest;
  not sent yet; window target keeps the desktop request (the stored 3/3/1/0x5 evidence) and lights GDI, not DXGI;
  quarantine; new connection. Mutant (the r1 rule requested != asked) -> 2 FAIL (refusal, same value); A/B/A is not
  told apart by that mutant.
- shared core: the intent across Request / ConsumePending / Query / Reset.
- AVD ua2 13/13 (new host, window target: the exact r2 lines, GDI kept for the desktop and lit, reconnect = host's own,
  never shown as an older host: states CHECKING -> IDLE). AVD ua2_old 7/7 (capture-lifecycle baseline host: "알려주지
  않습니다 · 보장할 수 없습니다", nothing lit, the change goes out, still unconfirmed; then a NEW host on a new connection:
  nothing carried). A delayed first pong cannot be staged on the manual TCP-control path (the client ends the session).

Product / test / docs: product (none) / test (unit, native, AVD scenarios) / docs (none).
